population: all nonfinancial industries under report-linked historical industry proxy
entry: Existing observed-first financial/audit ST or *ST, first of ANY ST must be target; entry announcement in 2012-2025
date_basis: announcement for entry, full recovery and final termination; verified adjudicated announcement overrides raw announcement; never substitute execution date
predictor_cutoff: strictly before entry announcement calendar date; same-day un-timestamped disclosures excluded
refit_policy: Fit exactly 3 frozen configurations x 3 seeds on entries through 2024 with follow-up capped at 12 calendar months and before 2025-01-01; evaluate 2025 entries once.

event_codes.1: final termination X before full recovery
event_codes.2: full recovery A before final termination

endpoint_scope: First full recovery versus all-cause final termination. T is not X; recovery then later termination is not counted as first termination. No lifetime eventual-delisting claim.
followup_source: Existing lossless primary event snapshot, bound 2026-09-03, with previously recorded researcher scope acceptance and preserved local exceptions. No extension to today's date.

standard_rsf.missing: training-only column median; no added missing-indicator dimensions

size_adaptation: Before any fit, reduce min_leaf 100 to 10 and min_groups 20 to 5 for the few-hundred-company cohort, equally for both Python forests. Other prior q2/unrestricted structure budgets retained. No performance-driven tuning.
evaluation: 2025 first outcomes at 12 calendar months, IPCW AUC/AP/Brier, risk mean, AJ observed incidence, Top20/25 known and unknown outcomes, 3/6-month warning lead; all seeds and fixed ensemble.
censoring: Marginal reverse Kaplan-Meier on evaluation cohort, left limits at observed events/horizons; known competing events are controls; unknown outcomes zero endpoint weight. Report support and no conditional-censoring robustness claim.
ranking: Within entry year, ceil(20%/25% of all test companies), deterministic sample ID tie-break; unknowns retained in ranks and never counted as false positives
interpretation: Exact complete q2 CIF decomposition for BOTH causes at 12 calendar months, fixed training reference, reload checks, native grid complexity and sparse-support audit; no information penalty or causal interpretation
uncertainty: Seed ranges are not confidence intervals. No automatic bootstrap refits in this small first run.
privacy: Company identities, raw rows, forecasts, thresholds, model/function parameters and individual explanations remain private on server
prior_exposure: 2023/2024 outcomes previously exposed; this protocol frozen before computing 2025 model results, but no independently sealed blind-test claim.
material_changes: training and test follow-up capped at 12 calendar months
unresolved_limitations: Original financial vintages not fully PIT certified
same-day annual reports still excluded under original announcement origin
inherited complete-source scope bound 2026-09-03, not today
origin_note: Original announcement-day origin retained; next-trading-day origin and original annual-report vintage recovery remain deferred.
comparison_note: New primary 12-month model is not a pure training-year ablation relative to 24-month fitted prior models.
